decisions.reason: As the firm's flagship platform and a core vehicle for its agency-focused direction, it is likely to be retained unless two years of results now clearly fall below aspiration levels, which the available signals do not suggest.

This hosting plan is close to the established business and benefits from a growing market and existing capabilities, though it still carries some risk of being folded into the core offer if its standalone performance lags aspirations.

The security-support offer fits the firm's compliance and support strengths and is still young enough to justify continued trial under organizational slack, but its narrower and more transitional character makes it the most plausible candidate for withdrawal if uptake disappoints.
